title: "About the American Beaver Party"
---

## A new system

The American Beaver Party Platform may appear radical in ideology but it is not. Some of the Platform positions are progressive and designed as aspirational. Progress is made in baby steps and some of the positions need time to develop. It is the goal of the Party to maintain the existing political and economic structure and work slowly in regards to change.

One of the most fundamental transitions is conversion to a political system that is based on the input and direction of the people. The influence on decision making will always be in conjunction with the desires of the general public. The Platform presented is both liberal and conservative and designed to be centric and inclusive to all of the citizens of America.


## Our mission

The American Beaver Party strives to protect individual liberty, develop a government that is responsive to the people, create a maintenance based economy, protect the environment and allow the human mind to develop without distraction.
